‘Amader School’ pays tribute to historic 7th March
2020-03-07T00:00:00+06:00 | Arts & Entertainment Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/news/amader-school-pays-tribute-historic-7th-march-1877308

Bangabandhu's iconic 7th March speech, is an inspiration for people from all walks of life. This time, Dhrubo Music Station is releasing a new song, titled Amader School, today, commemorating the historic day.

The song is written and tuned by Michil Bongobashi and arranged by Ibrar Tipu. Popular artistes, S I Tutul, Akhi Alamgir, Ibrar Tipu, Michil Bongobashi and Bindukona sang the song. Soumitra Ghosh Emon conceived the music video.

The song will be released on the official YouTube Channel of Dhrubo Music Station today.
